sonnet.problem: The story card's joke ('he is NOT stopping by to drop off a cookie box') signals that Solomon is going to conquer Hamath-zobah. That gives away the answer to the true/false card right after it (he captures it). The true/false card then only repeats the same verse the story card just set up.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The question states 'Solomon keeps the Israelites out of slave labor.' That is the fact card 8 just revealed as its answer (False), and verse 9 is asked twice, so the question re-asks a fact already shown.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
